column3: API Gateway adds IAM condition keys controlling endpoint exposure, authorization and TLS through existing IAM policies and SCPs.
MemoryDB changes its contractual Multi-AZ availability SLA from 99.9% to 99.99%; no functional product change is stated.
EventBridge adds GitHub, Stripe and Twilio sources through deployable webhook templates for its existing event ingestion operation.
Elastic Disaster Recovery adds Outposts racks as replication and recovery destinations while explicitly retaining the same functionality.
EventBridge Pipes gains private VPC connectivity through PrivateLink for existing Pipes operations.
Data Exchange for Redshift describes direct subscription-based queries and automated entitlements at GA but identifies no functional change from any prior preview.
CloudWatch cross-account observability adds Service Quotas as another monitored resource type with dashboards and alarms.
Batch introduces a queue-front snapshot operation showing fair-share scheduling order through its console and GetJobQueueSnapshot API.
EMR on EKS enriches the existing DescribeJobRun response with relevant driver-log error details.
Data Exchange introduces in-place subscriber access to provider S3 objects without copies, with access governed by subscriptions.
Launch Wizard adds an option to place SQL Server tempdb on instance-store volumes during the existing deployment flow.
Proton allows environments to link existing shared resources via customer-managed templates instead of provisioning those resources anew.
AMS Accelerate becomes available in GovCloud; the text describes existing operational capabilities without a functional delta.
Alongside regional expansion, the post explicitly makes Graviton2 instances the default ElastiCache choice; other described changes are routine hardware and runtime versions.
JumpStart adds a programmatic Python interface explicitly enabling automated deployment and training of previously one-click models.
Customer Profiles now automatically stores Connect contact history in unified customer profiles, replacing the described custom profile-building work.
Bedrock Blueprints are open-source sample templates for experimenting and learning with existing agents, actions, guardrails and knowledge bases.
The WorkSpaces webcam GA post describes video redirection but does not distinguish new functionality from pre-GA webcam support.
Personalize gains an integrated Data Wrangler preparation workflow with transformations and exploration before dataset import.
B2B Data Interchange adds automatic generation of 997 and TA1 acknowledgement artifacts and corresponding delivery-triggering events.
Private 5G adds multiple radio units and additional SIM ordering to scale an existing private network.
FSx File Gateway introduces a deployable gateway type with local caching to extend managed FSx shares on premises, a substantial Storage Gateway subsystem.
Advanced NodeJS Driver GA describes topology-aware failover and authentication features but does not establish an inaugural launch or a functional GA delta.
CloudFormation extends AllowedValues and AllowedPattern validation controls to CommaDelimitedList parameters.
Lambda explicitly improves synchronous scaling rates to 1000 executions per ten seconds per function with automatic enablement; this is scaling behavior and performance.
Q Business adds Smartsheet to its existing set of index synchronization connectors.
Redshift adds SQL MERGE and multidimensional aggregation operations including CUBE and ROLLUP; these outweigh the accompanying size-limit increase.
DocumentDB adds managed unplanned global failover preserving cluster topology, distinct from its existing planned switchover operation.
HealthImaging extends its existing DICOM import operation to S3 buckets in other accounts and regions.
Time Sync adds configurable PTP hardware-clock support and clock-accuracy auditing alongside automatic NTP accuracy improvements.
EC2 adds a bare-metal size of the existing C7gn family with specified capacity and networking characteristics.
Amplify announces in-app messaging GA and describes campaign and UI features without specifying changes from its prior release stage.
IoT Device Management adds reusable templates and access controls for existing remote job actions and their deployment parameters.
Lake Formation expands to Zurich; the body only explains established data-lake capabilities.
IAM adds centralized removal of member-account root credentials and scoped privileged operations using temporary credentials.
CloudFormation gains PCS resource support for creating and managing existing cluster resources through infrastructure templates.
Step Functions gains a general AWS SDK invocation interface spanning service API actions, beyond the previous curated service integrations.
Neptune GSP adds whole-named-graph variants of existing fetch, insert and delete operations; the source explicitly contrasts these with multiple existing SPARQL queries.
FinSpace Scaling Groups allow multiple existing kdb clusters to share provisioned compute, adding a placement and utilization option.
